title: Advertising by administrator.
bodyText: An administrator shall use only the advertising pertaining to the business an insurer has underwritten and approved in advance of its use.
bodyHtml: [§431:9J-107]  Advertising by administrator.  An administrator shall use only the advertising pertaining to the business an insurer has underwritten and approved in advance of its use. [L 2019, c 72, pt of §1]
